Who we are

More than a service. Care that comes home.

Over the years, we have seen firsthand how powerful a familiar and comfortable environment can be in the healing process. That’s why we are committed to bringing our skills, knowledge, and passion directly into the homes of those who need us most.

Our Certified Nursing Assistants and Personal Support Specialists provide personal care and daily support, with compassion and respect, so you can keep living comfortably in your home.

Life at home

Care, comfort and community.

Everyday moments with our team.

Questions

In-home care in Lewiston: what families ask first.

Something else on your mind? Call +1 (207) 751-7327. We’re happy to help.

What kinds of care do you provide?

One on one care, mobility and safe movement support, help with meals and light activities, grocery shopping, bathing, grooming, personal hygiene, and companionship.

Who provides the care?

Our Certified Nursing Assistants and Personal Support Specialists. They are the heart of daily care, with compassion and respect.

Where is the care given?

In your own home, in familiar and comfortable surroundings.

How do I get started?

Call +1 (207) 751-7327 or send us a message. We will talk through your loved one’s needs and preferences.

Can you help with bathing and grooming?

Yes. We assist with bathing, grooming, and personal hygiene.

Do you help with meals and errands?

Yes. We support with meals and light activities, and assist with grocery shopping.

Is companionship part of your care?

Yes. We offer companionship and encouragement along with hands-on support.

What are your business hours?

Our office is open Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm.

About us

About Mary’s House

Providing care with compassion and empathy to your loved ones.

A familiar place is where healing happens.

Over the years, we have seen firsthand how powerful a familiar and comfortable environment can be in the healing process. That’s why we are committed to bringing our skills, knowledge, and passion directly into the homes of those who need us most.

Our Certified Nursing Assistants and Personal Support Specialists provide personal care and daily support to help you keep living in the comfort of your home. They are the heart of daily care, giving hands-on support with compassion and respect.
